title: Sylvester matrix equation AX + XB = C
prompt:
Find the 3×3 matrix X that satisfies the matrix equation A·X + X·B = C, where

A =
[ -3  -3   1 ]
[  2   1  -3 ]
[ -4  -3   2 ]

B =
[  3  -4   3 ]
[ -4  -1   0 ]
[  4   4   1 ]

C =
[   2   -4  -25 ]
[  -1   24   30 ]
[  14  -52  -19 ]

(the solution is unique). Give the 9 entries of X row by row as exact numbers separated by commas.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
